command: P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; printf '%s\n' '=== LOCAL CLASSIFICATION VS ORIGIN/MAIN ==='; while IFS= read -r b; do test "$b" = main && continue; if git -C "$P" merge-base --is-ancestor "$b" origin/main 2>/dev/null; then m=MERGED; else m=UNMERGED; fi; ab=$(git -C "$P" rev-list --left-right --count "$b"...origin/main | tr '\t' '/'); printf '%s|%s|ahead/behind=%s\n' "$b" "$m" "$ab"; done < <(git -C "$P" for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads | sort)
